content:
With just weeks to go before its premiere, Apple TV today released the trailer for the second season of Women in Blue. Watch the video below.

Women in Blue returns on August 12

Two years ago, almost to the day, Women in Blue (Las Azules) debuted on Apple TV with a 10-episode first season.

The Spanish-language crime series tells the story of "four women who defy the ultraconservative norms of the era to become Mexico's first female police officers, only to discover their unit is a PR stunt designed to distract the press from a brutal serial killer," per Apple TV's synopsis.

Women in Blue, inspired by true events, was renewed for a second season in May 2025 and now has an air date: August 12.

Apple TV today unveiled the trailer for season two, which the streamer says will see Azules investigate a murder connected to the 1968 student massacre.
